eligibility: RepositoryData checksum validation; build_training_windows once; eligible_training per target; strict label cutoff; exclude entire cold-start target parent; exclude missing between-VTD baselines per API; no further candidate-specific exclusions; fail on nonfinite required fitting values
history: Each historical window uses its own cutoff-specific hydraulic QA; T-only intervals frozen once per section/window/hold; no W/v gate, spatial temperatures, fallback or extrapolation; empty history retains zero exposure and residual
rate_fit: One nonnegative reference rate per case/hold/policy/candidate: max(0,sum(w*E*loss)/sum(w*E^2)); unavailable for zero denominator; negative observed loss retained
weighting: Existing sample_weights W1, recomputed for every calibration set; no section-specific primary rates
metrics: Unclipped W1 SSE and sqrt(SSE/sum(w)); separate clipped-thickness MAE/RMSE/bias and Pearson squared only for nonconstant vectors; relative SSE change versus EA00 and minimum; zero comparator: zero if equal, otherwise null with explicit status
folds: First audit strict forward-time held-parent folds on target-specific permitted windows. If absent, leave one simple-section id out within each parent/campaign having >=3 sections, hold all its segments/windows together, recompute W1. Identical timestamp/duration/temperature trajectories across calibration/test invalidate grouped fold. Shared calendar/operating histories reported. No random split or bootstrap.
grouped_metric: Equal contribution of held-out sections, using paired clipped-thickness MAE; publish per-section metrics and ranks. Scores are selection diagnostics, never unbiased final estimates.
sensitivity: Columns sqrt(w)*r*E [mm per log(rate)] and sqrt(w)*r*dE/dEa [mm per kJ/mol]. Report raw SVD and conventional machine-epsilon rank, plus unit-column SVD/rank at 1e-6. Zero rate/column is degenerate. dE/dEa=sum(dt*F*1000/R*(1/Tref-1/T)); reference gap derivative zero.
decision_rules: Training SSE alone cannot choose. Candidates within 1% of minimum SSE are fit ties, explicitly handle zero minimum.
Unique primary best equal-section held-out MAE under BOTH gap policies; >=3 usable section holdouts required for internal provisional choice. Differences below max(0.01mm,1% comparator MAE) tie.
No meaningful shorter-hold reversal under either policy; candidate must beat EA00 beyond same tolerance and have distinguishable exposure shape.
Withhold unique choice if rank deficient, effectively proportional, gap-dependent, or dependent on one held-out section. Delete-one-section aggregate perturbations must preserve the unique candidate.

If EA00 ties, retain it. No usable transfer or no distinguishable shape => indeterminate; otherwise unresolved practical ties/sensitivity => candidate_set_retained. Conservatively retain full fixed grid whenever no unique choice is supported.
Shared recommendation requires same supported choice in both cases. Never pool cases or policies. EA40 continuity is software-only and not experiment selection.
associations: Per-window and deduplicated per-case eligible contributing timestamps: pairwise finite T, elapsed years from window start, watercut_pct_usable, v_liquid_true_usable. Publish pair counts, missingness and Pearson association, descriptive only.
uncertainty: No population confidence intervals from one parent/campaign; overlapping trajectories and leave-section perturbations are not independent replication.
excluded: Legacy theta=2500K, continuous optimization, extra grid values, chemistry coefficients, production forecasts and target-based selection
provenance: Focused clean-chat preamble supersedes broad initial reading; no new full-spec reading or external literature. Prior Russian v1.1 substitution is handoff context, not a claim of rereading.
